CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to any identified content was found.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates), an explicit organization/presentation pattern (full-grid coordinate lists), and a distinct origin/status entry are present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement is linked to a specific content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifications name colors (red/blue) bound to coordinate sets for named referents.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields (copied_prior_record, history_estimate, command_estimate) are provided separately from content coordinates, distinguishing identification from status/organization.

O.rationale: Content is presented as explicit coordinate sets and named candidate/current nodes, indicating organized presentation patterns and accessibility.
